device.basis: Second DRAM controller of X-T20 2.11 section 5: start-up waits for +0x14c bit 3 (done) and reads the calibration result 0x3a from +0x614 bits 23:16. After a still, reccont (0xc6c64c) writes +0xb8 = 0x6a020202 and waits for +0xbc bits 5..0 = 0x27, and 0xc6c700 writes 0x01020202 and waits for 0x20; these are the only +0xb8 commands (REC deinit and re-init). What the states mean is not known.
